nodes.title: Why Choose ZX Bank for Business Loans?
nodes.summary: Reasons to choose ZX Bank for business financing: pan-South Asia presence (India, Sri Lanka, Bangladesh, Bhutan, Nepal), fast approvals via e-KYC and a digital application process, customized products for SMEs, corporates, exporters, and women-led businesses, flexible repayment options matching cash flow, and full digital loan management through the ZX Bank Asia app or NetBanking.

nodes.title: Types of Business Loans Offered
nodes.summary: Introduces the six business loan categories ZX Bank offers: working capital loans, term loans, SME loans, trade finance solutions, women empowerment loans, and green & sustainability loans.

children.title: 1. **Working Capital Loans**
children.summary: Working capital loans finance day-to-day expenses, inventory purchase, receivables coverage, and ongoing business operations.

children.title: 2. **Term Loans**
children.summary: Term loans support business expansion, asset purchase, or infrastructure development and are available with both short-term and long-term tenures.

children.title: 3. **SME Loans**
children.summary: SME loans are a special category for micro, small, and medium enterprises offering minimal paperwork and attractive interest rates.

children.title: 4. **Trade Finance Solutions**
children.summary: Trade finance solutions include Letters of Credit, Bank Guarantees, Bill Discounting, and other export/import funding instruments.

children.title: 5. **Women Empowerment Loans**
children.summary: Women empowerment loans are tailored for women entrepreneurs and women-led businesses across South Asia.

children.title: 6. **Green & Sustainability Loans**
children.summary: Green and sustainability loans finance renewable energy, eco-friendly infrastructure, and climate-smart business initiatives.

nodes.title: How to Apply?
nodes.summary: Application process for business loans: visit a branch or apply online via the ZX Bank Asia app; eligible entities include proprietorships, partnerships, private/public limited companies, start-ups, and women entrepreneurs meeting KYC and credit criteria; documents such as business proof, financial statements, KYC, and a project report are submitted digitally; approval is fast-tracked with doorstep service for eligible applicants and the loan is managed through the app.

nodes.title: Need Guidance?
nodes.summary: Support available for business loan applicants: the Zia AI finance assistant in the ZX Bank Asia app instantly checks eligibility, required documents, and estimated EMIs, while dedicated relationship managers provide personalized solutions and on-ground support.

nodes.title: Empower Your Business With ZX Bank
nodes.summary: Closing section positioning ZX Bank as the financing partner for startups and established corporates across India, Sri Lanka, Bangladesh, Bhutan, and Nepal, ending with an Apply Now call to action.
